title: hybrid.rs HybridRouter is a production-unwired parallel router using pre-AddrForKey link-local gradient destinations
description: Found during ywec.2 (worker8, 2026-09-09). rust/lichen-node/src/hybrid.rs defines HybridRouter, a self-contained router with its own gradient_table, that is NEVER instantiated in production (grep: no HybridRouter::new outside hybrid.rs/tests; the production announce path is rpl_stack/receive.rs -> AnnounceProcessor). Its process_announce (hybrid.rs:487) builds gradient destinations as link-local fe80::||iid — the pre-AddrForKey form — while the production AnnounceProcessor (announce.rs:222) writes routable ygg_addr_from_pubkey /128s. Each table is internally consistent today BECAUSE they are separate and HybridRouter is unwired. RISK: if HybridRouter is ever wired into the production path, its link-local gradient destinations will silently mismatch routable lookups (gradient.rs lookup matches full 16 bytes; there is no lookup_by_iid). Also its learn_from_data/on_rrep_received take caller-provided dst/src of unspecified form. OPTIONS: (a) migrate HybridRouter::process_announce to ygg_addr_from_pubkey for consistency with the production form; (b) mark HybridRouter as test/sim-only and exclude from production builds; (c) delete if fully superseded by the AnnounceProcessor/rpl_stack path. Decide intent for HybridRouter before any production wiring.
